title: StockSmart Storeroom Desk Reference — Corbett's Reorder Point Entry for a New Consigned Bin
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program.** When a customer's written request for a new consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of its VendPoint machines stands on a program, Corbett records that bin's reorder point under the StockSmart consigned reorder point schedule as a par level entry that keeps the bin consigned and keeps its item, its flags and its fill-to level.

Corbett's reorder point for such a bin is recorded only after the customer's new-bin entry for it, flagged consigned, stands in the program's bin history.

Restated in the terms of the records: the reorder point entry is Corbett's, and the program's bin history must already show that bin's new-bin entry, flagged consigned, made on the customer's request, before that entry is recorded.

### Recording the entry: `record_consigned_reorder_point_33b5bdc5`

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books a single par change entry for the bin, effective today. The bin stays consigned, keeps the item, the special-stock and critical flags and the fill-to level passed in, and takes the reorder point passed in, the level at or below which the bin is refilled. Corbett's own entries carry a review reference of the form VBR-NNNNNN.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the StockSmart program that holds the bin, read from the StockSmart program lookup | identifier |
| `bin_label` | the bin label exactly as it appears on the bin's latest entry in the bin history | text, copied character for character |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number exactly as it appears on the bin's latest entry | text, copied character for character |
| `special_stock` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the item as non-catalog special stock | `true` or `false` |
| `critical_item` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the bin critical | `true` or `false` |
| `max_qty` | the bin's fill-to level as it stands on the bin's latest entry | whole number of units |
| `min_qty` | the reorder point being recorded | whole number of units of the item, 0 or more |

### Receipt

On success the receipt shows `status` "recorded", `vmi_bin_id` (the reference number of the par entry), `change_reference` (format VBR-NNNNNN), `bin_label`, `sku`, `min_qty` and `max_qty` in whole units, `consigned` (always true) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no other outcome.

### Points of the entry

- The entry is a par level entry, not a new bin: the bin, its item, its flags and its fill-to level carry over as they stand.
- The flags and the fill-to level passed in are read from the bin's latest entry; only the reorder point is new.
